intro: Nigeria has over 220 million people, more than any other African country, and over 500 languages.

chapters.title: Many peoples
text: The largest groups are the Hausa and Fulani in the north, the Yoruba in the south-west and the Igbo in the south-east. English is the official language, and Nigerian Pidgin is widely spoken.
Roughly half the people are Muslim, mostly in the north, and half Christian, mostly in the south.

chapters.title: Lagos and the young
text: Lagos is one of Africa's largest cities. Most Nigerians are under 20, and the population is growing fast.

keyTerms.meaning: A simplified language used between groups.
